ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Encontra-me uses Face ID to sign in to your account on this phone.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Encontra-me uses your location while the app is open to show nearby cases, mark sightings and, when you ask, send your location to a contact.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Encontra-me uses the camera to take the photo for a person's or a pet's registration.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Encontra-me accesses your photos so you can choose the photo for a person's or a pet's registration.
